text:
47세 여성, acute severe asthma exacerbation으로 입원함.

BP 135/85 mmHg.  
HR 110 bpm.  
RR 32 breaths/min.  
BT 37.5°C.  
SpO2 88% on room air 확인됨.  

Severe wheezing 확인됨.  

Albuterol 2.5 mg IV q4h 적용함.  

High-flow nasal cannula 산소 공급 유지함.  

NG tube 삽입됨.  

Negative fluid balance of 500 ml 확인됨.  

환자 상태 drowsy.  

Pulmonology team notify함.
